title: Speaking Practice 25 - Work-Life Balance
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about work-life balance.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Work-Life Balance Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: Is work-life balance achievable in modern society?

explanation.sampleAnswer: It is challenging but achievable with the right boundaries. The key is setting clear limits on working hours and prioritizing health and relationships alongside career goals.

questions.content: Has remote work improved work-life balance?

explanation.sampleAnswer: For some people yes, as it eliminates commuting and offers flexibility. But for others, working from home has blurred the boundary between work and personal time.

questions.content: Should companies offer more flexible working hours?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, research shows that flexible schedules increase productivity and employee satisfaction. As long as deadlines are met, the exact hours should not matter.

questions.content: What are the consequences of overworking?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Burnout, health problems, strained relationships, and ironically, decreased productivity. Countries like Japan even have a term for death from overwork: karoshi.
